Country.evidence_source: Multi-group CFAs were performed on the BAS-2 across both sex and country. The results displayed in Table 4 and Supplementary Table 5 indicate that there was evidence of metric and partial scalar invariance across Denmark and Portugal (metric -CFI = .003, scalar -CFI = .024, and partial scalar -CFI = .008); Denmark and Sweden (metric -CFI = .001, scalar -CFI = .016, and partial scalar -CFI = .008); and Portugal and Sweden (metric -CFI = .004, scalar -CFI = .020, and partial scalar -CFI = .007).
